==Biography==
'''RedBert''' became known as part of [[Seven Wars e-Sports]], the team that surprised the Brazilian e-sports community by qualifying to [[IEM Season VIII - Sao Paulo|IEM Sao Paulo]] in early 2014. However, due to his age, he couldn't play at the tournament. Shortly after, all five members were caught in the Elo Boosting/Drophacking/Scripting ban wave, and the team was disbanded. He then played for [[RMA e-Sports]] for three months, and stayed away from the competitive spotlight until May 2015, when he joined [[Big Gods]] to play in the [[Brazilian Challenger Circuit/2015 Season/Split 2|Brazilian Challenger Circuit Split 2 2015]]. Despite being part of the campaign that qualified the team in second place, by Riot rules, he couldn't play in the [[CBLOL/2016 Season/Split 1 Promotion|CBLOL Promotion Series]] due to his age, becoming eligible to play only at the start of the 2016 season. Due to that, he became a substitute. In the end of August, he was announced as the support for [[g3nerationX]], to play in the [[Brasil Mega Arena/Sao Paulo 2015|BRMA São Paulo 2015]] as a temporary stand-in, with the possibility of joining permanently later.

== Trivia ==
* Missed some official Riot and ESL tournaments in 2014 and 2015 due to his age, being officially eligible to play at the 2016 season.
* Was a well known {{ci|Thresh}} OTP before becoming a pro player.
* His nickname comes from the '''[[wikipedia:en:M&M's|m&m's]]''' red toy named "Redbert Einstein".
** Began to be nicknaned "'''GreenBert'''" after joining [[LOUD]].<ref>[https://x.com/ilhadaslendas/status/1749168315094700260 Ilha das Lendas' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* Is sometimes nicknamed '''"Bygor"''', which is a mix between his first name and his IGN.
* Often remembered for his {{ci|tahm kench}} outplay in a 3v2 dive playing for [[INTZ]] against [[paiN Gaming]] in the [[CBLOL 2020 Split 2 Playoffs|2020 finals]].<ref>[https://twitter.com/imagensdocblol/status/1436048778671312902 Imagens Do CBLOL Antes De Dar Merda's Tweet]''twitter.com''</ref>
* He has a {{ci|Braum}} tattoo which he made after winning his first '''CBLOL''' title.<ref>[https://x.com/LOUDgg/status/1915876048161431965 LOUD's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* He was the first player to win 3 titles against [[paiN Gaming|paiN]] on 3 different teams: [[Team oNe eSports]], [[INTZ]] and [[LOUD]].
* He was the first Brazilian support to win 5 titles with 5 different ADCS: [[Absolut]], [[Mills]], [[MicaO]], [[Route]] and [[Bull]].
* His {{ci|rell}} engage against [[FURIA]] got featured in '''LoL Esports Top 5 Plays of the Week''' as '''Top 5'''.<ref>[https://x.com/lolesports/status/1826273061907190060 LoL Esports' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* He revealed in a interview that he was diagnosed with ''ADHD'' during his time at [[FURIA]] after his girlfriend constantly reported that he had symptoms of the disorder.<ref>[https://youtu.be/J7AwGoc7ttE?si=juvK0QzG7QT7qNeS&t=468 Como os jogadores lidam com a pressão em um momento decisivo - CBLOL 2024 - 2ª Etapa] ''youtube.com''</ref>
